messages:
marta (People Ops): Quick heads-up 1: Mei Chen is coming by tomorrow ~15:00 to drop off a large bouquet + a small crate (courier). She asked for step-free access and a low stool. Can someone meet the courier, grab a dolly, and tag the crate FRAGILE? Also need a short-term bench/table near the cafe for a 15:20 chat. Thanks!

owen: I can meet the courier at 14:45 and bring my folding dolly from Locker 2. Will move crate to Locker C1 and mark FRAGILE.

claire: I'll print a visitor badge. What should it read "Guest of Growth" vs "Visiting: Mei"? Also will print a Wi-Fi card. Quick seat poll: bench / couch / desk 4?

mailroom: If the crate contains ceramics, definitely tag FRAGILE. We can provide a small vase for the bouquet and keep flowers on the hospitality shelf for a few hours. Please add delivery to the sheet: https://redwood-internal/deliveries.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registration found: Mei Chen ID uploaded, vehicle plate QXZ-990, courier tracking #C987654. ETA window 14:45-15:05.

facilities: We'll drop a dolly by the main doors at 14:30 and a folding stool by the cafe bench. Also bringing a short folding table in case the piece needs a flat surface. :package: :chair:

mei (visitor): Hi all Mei here. Thanks so much! I'll aim for ~14:50 with one wrapped bouquet and a small crate of ceramics (fragile). Appreciate the step-free access note. See you soon.

owen: Note please don't wedge flowers near the vents, they wilt fast. I'll water the bouquet and put it in a vase at hospitality shelf.

claire: Badge printed as "Visiting: Mei" + Wi-Fi card (RedwoodGuest_2026). Bench by cafe reserved and labeled "Guest: Mei".

marta (People Ops): Awesome all thanks. Reminder to log any delivery issues in the sheet and tag me if the courier leaves without signing. I'll ping security if parking's weird. :heart:

claire: :thumbsup:
